comment: A Flange on several edges (mitcad#1872; tools/ui-sheet-flange-edges-test.sh and its Windows twin): sheet rules F1 (t = 1, r = 1, K = 0.44), Sketch1 F2 with a 40 x 30 rectangle at the origin and the sheet Face F3 (F3.b0) on it, its side faces y = 0, x = 40 and y = 30 free for one Flange (as cli.sheet_flange_edges).

The rules keep flange corners as designs made before their corner relief at flange corners did (flange_corner_relief false, mitcad#2342, mitcad#2411): this script checks the corners themselves; the rules' relief there is checked by cli.sheet_flange_corner_relief, cli.sheet_flange_edges_corner_relief and cli.sheet_flange_corner_relief_types.
